vibe: Zimbra is on fire — a critical mail-server RCE under active attack leads a heavy exploitation day, with CISA, WordPress and even NASA in the mix.

cyber.title: Critical Zimbra RCE flaw now actively exploited in attacks
cyber.summary: A critical remote-code-execution bug in Zimbra is being exploited in the wild right now. If you run a Zimbra mail server, patch immediately — this is the day's top must-do.

cyber.title: Agentic AI presents a new insider-threat model for organizations
cyber.summary: Dark Reading argues autonomous AI agents with system access behave like a novel class of insider threat — worth thinking about as agents get real permissions.

cyber.title: CISA warns of hackers exploiting a critical MLflow vulnerability
cyber.summary: CISA flags active exploitation of a critical flaw in MLflow, the popular ML lifecycle platform. Patch if you run ML infrastructure.

cyber.title: ~2,000 hacked WordPress sites spreading malware (StopAndProtect)
cyber.summary: Nearly 2,000 compromised WordPress sites are pushing malware and stealing data. Audit plugins/admin accounts if you run WordPress.

cyber.title: NASA AIT-GUI flaws could let unauthenticated attackers issue spacecraft commands
cyber.summary: Vulnerabilities in NASA's open-source AIT-GUI ground software could let unauthenticated attackers send spacecraft commands. Niche but striking.

cyber.title: CareCloud healthtech breach exposes 3.7 million patients
cyber.summary: Health-tech firm CareCloud disclosed a breach affecting 3.7M patient records.

cyber.title: Password-spraying attacks surge 155x as attackers exploit MFA gaps
cyber.summary: A 155-fold jump in password-spraying against weak/missing MFA. Tighten MFA coverage.

cyber.title: Cloudflare Workers hit by Spectre attack leaking JWTs (corroborated HN + THN)
cyber.summary: A revived remote Spectre attack leaks JWTs from a co-located Cloudflare Worker at ~12 bits/sec. Flagged on both Hacker News and The Hacker News.

ai.title: OpenAI confirms ChatGPT outage as logins and signups fail
ai.summary: ChatGPT went down with login/signup failures, confirmed by OpenAI. Transient but disruptive.

ai.title: OpenAI pauses frontier RL training to harden against unsafe AI behavior
ai.summary: OpenAI halted some frontier reinforcement-learning runs while tightening safety defenses.

ai.title: Phishing 3.0: the fight moves to agent-versus-agent
ai.summary: As attackers automate phishing with AI agents, defenders deploy their own — early agent-vs-agent security dynamics.

it.title: Framework responds to complaints that a BIOS update bricks Ryzen 7040 laptops
it.summary: Framework is handling reports that a BIOS update bricked some Ryzen 7040 laptops. Hold off updating if you own one.

it.title: Google stops pushing Git tags for some Android source code
it.summary: Google quietly stopped publishing Git tags for parts of the Android source — an openness signal that irked the community.

videos.title: DeepSeek Just Made Closed AI Look Ridiculous
videos.verdict: SKIM — the news is the model, not the 8 minutes
videos.summary: DeepSeek 4 Pro (build 0813), MIT-licensed open weights, markedly better structural understanding than the earlier preview. DeepSeek raised hosted prices 2.5-5x, but open weights let rival hosts undercut them.
